description: The Countywide Comprehensive Parks and Recreation Needs Assessment quantified the need for parks and recreation resources across Los Angeles County, in cities and unincorporated areas, and estimated the potential cost of meeting it. Its inventory and analysis of parks and open space generated maps and new data points that the department publishes as study-area profile PDFs, an interactive map viewer and GIS downloads hosted on the county enterprise GIS data portal. Coverage: all of Los Angeles County, organised by study area. Access: free map viewer, PDFs and GIS data through the county portal; the executive summary and fact sheet are offered in several languages. Licence: none stated on the project site. Caveats: the core assessment dates from 2016, and a 2022 Parks Needs Assessment Plus extends it, so figures should be checked against the newer work. Simulation uses: park access and equity analysis, siting new parks and cooling or flood-retention open space, and cost estimation of park investment. Related records: the TPL ParkServe layer and the San Diego park locations.
